title: Resort Club Memberships Early Termination Charge
content:
When the termination date of a Resort Club Memberships membership falls before the end of the minimum term, an early termination charge is invoiced on termination. The end of the minimum term is the level's minimum term, in months, from the start date, extended by any frozen months.

## The charge

| Basis of the level | Early termination charge |
|---|---|
| Flat fee | The level's early termination charge under the flat fee basis |
| Remaining-term dues | The dues of the months remaining in the minimum term |

The basis, the minimum term and the flat-fee amount are the level's own, as its term and cancellation schedule sets them.

## Waiver on relocation

The charge is waived when the member permanently moves more than the level's relocation distance in miles from the resort and gives proof of the new residence with the notice. Both parts are needed: a permanent move of more than that distance, and proof of the new residence given with the notice. A cancellation notice given on such a move appears on the membership's notice records as a relocation cancellation notice.

## Once only

The early termination charge is invoiced at most once. A membership carries no more than one early termination charge on its account.

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

**Flat fee level with a freeze.** A membership started on 1 March 2025 at a level with a minimum term of 12 months, and was frozen for 2 months. The minimum term runs 12 months from 1 March 2025 to 1 March 2026, extended by the 2 frozen months to 1 May 2026.

| Termination date | Falls before the end of the minimum term (1 May 2026) | Early termination charge |
|---|---|---|
| 15 April 2026 | Yes | Invoiced on termination: the level's flat fee |
| 20 May 2026 | No | Not invoiced |

**Remaining-term dues level.** A membership started on 1 January 2025 at a level with a minimum term of 24 months, never frozen, so the minimum term ends on 1 January 2027. With a termination date of 1 January 2026, the months remaining in the minimum term are the 12 months from 1 January 2026 to 1 January 2027, and the charge is the dues of those 12 months.

## Relocation distance (hypothetical)

At a level whose relocation distance is 50 miles:

| Permanent move from the resort | Proof of the new residence given with the notice | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| 72 miles | Yes | Waived |
| 72 miles | No | Not waived |
| Exactly 50 miles | Yes | Not waived: 50 miles is not more than 50 miles |
